title: hoya gongshanica
intro: Hoya gongshanica, commonly known as the waxy monkey orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Hoya gongshanica include acting as a nervine tonic, which helps to calm the nervous system, and its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and alkaloids, are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
